# Locally sourced Windows fonts

Meiryo UI Regular/Bold and Times New Roman Regular/Bold were read from this
computer's C:/Windows/Fonts on 2026-10-10 for the requested local application.
Meiryo UI faces were extracted from meiryo.ttc and meiryob.ttc; Times New Roman
uses times.ttf and timesbd.ttf. These fonts are not covered by the SIL OFL
licenses of the other bundled fonts. Original font name/copyright tables are
preserved. This project does not grant font redistribution rights.

Run scripts/import-windows-fonts.py with Python and fontTools to regenerate the
TTF binaries and Base64 modules from the installed Windows font files.
